data.name: BODIPY-based boronate ester macrocycle with pyridine linkers
data.note: Structure contains two BODIPY (boron-dipyrromethene) cores (each with Me substituents), each linked via boronate ester bridges to pentafluorophenyl groups; central core includes two pyridinium units (N+ in aromatic ring) connected through boronate esters to additional BODIPY-like fragments. The symmetry suggests a macrocyclic or dimeric assembly. Key features: B(OR)2 boronate esters, perfluorinated aryl rings (C6F5), methyl-substituted fused aromatic (BODIPY) systems, and pyridine N-oxides or pyridinium linkers (arrow indicates coordination/dative bond to B). Due to complexity and possible non-standard representation, SMILES is approximate for the major connectivity.
